# Test fixtures: drafts

The three drafts as they were on `main` before their first publication (P2-13, E55): Ekurhuleni Tariff B 1-phase and 3-phase for 2026/27, and the SARS VAT rate from 1 April 2018. Every value is `estimated`, as transcribed in P1-9.

They are test inputs only, in the layout of `data/drafts/` (ADR-0012), for tests that publish, load or check drafts in a temporary copy. They are not MuniSense's data: the published versions are under `data/tariffs/` and `data/vat/`, and nothing in `src/` reads this folder. Transcription notes: `docs/domain/ekurhuleni-2026-27.md`.
